system_definitions.A: General-purpose LLM with the same versioned source context; no calculation tools.
system_definitions.B: The identical LLM, prompt configuration and source context as A, with equivalent deterministic calculation tools.
system_definitions.C: Complete local prototype workflow: server-side role filtering, local-extractive source responses, deterministic Python calculations and validation. No LLM is used by the offline run; formal same-LLM A/B/C comparison is pending.

instructions: Use synthetic inputs only. Act as Actuarial Analyst. Do not disclose internal or restricted source content. Return normalized outputs using the field names in each case. Capital is illustrative, not HK RBC compliant. For citations return source document_id@version. Do not invent citations or numerical results. Use identical cases and context for all systems. Report unavailable tasks honestly.

cases.prompt: Value SYN-ZERO using annual effective 5% yield, no spread, no coupon, HKD1,000,000 principal. Valuation 2020-01-01; maturity 2024-01-01. Use ACT/365.25 discount times. Return price_hkd and dv01_hkd_per_bp.

Compare HKD40m opening equity at 2025-12-31 against HKD50m closing equity at 2026-09-30 under an illustrative 30% equity shock. Rate and credit modules are zero. Return opening_capital_hkd, closing_capital_hkd, movement_hkd, shapley_total_hkd and residual_hkd.
cases.derivation: With only equity capital nonzero, aggregate capital = equity exposure * 30%. Exact equity attribution = HKD3m; the other two allocations are zero.

cases.prompt: Illustrative correlation order (rate, credit, equity): [[1,.25,.25],[.25,1,.5],[.25,.5,1]]. Opening modules HKD(10m,20m,30m); closing HKD(12m,18m,36m). Aggregate sqrt(c^T R c). Allocate the aggregate change by exact Shapley across all 6 orderings. Return opening_capital_hkd, closing_capital_hkd, movement_hkd, shapley_total_hkd and residual_hkd.
cases.derivation: Opening quadratic form in million-HKD units: 100+400+900+100+150+600=2250. Closing:144+324+1296+108+216+648=2736. The Shapley sum telescopes to their square-root difference.
